messages.content: What is the largest planet in the universe?

function.name: space_star_info

message.content:
The largest planet that has been confirmed in the entire observable universe is the exoplanet **HD 100546 b**.  
It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius of roughly **2.5–3 times that of Jupiter**, making it the biggest planet we’ve found so far. (In our own Solar System, Jupiter is the largest planet.)
